profile_text.body:
MarketMuse describes itself as AI content planning and optimization software. According to its site, the software tells users what content to write and how much, with the aim of leveraging their experience and ranking higher where competitors are weak. The company says its patented AI analyzes an entire content inventory, then identifies high-value topic clusters and quick wins based on the authority a site already has.

The company states it has used AI in its product for over ten years. For every page and topic analyzed, it says its AI fetches hundreds to thousands of pages of content, removes low quality outliers, and uses a combination of proprietary and open source algorithms to classify parts of speech and calculate their relevance. MarketMuse also says its Optimize application includes a generative AI component to help users create content faster, while stating that it does not write content for customers. Its stated focus is helping users understand what to write and how much, build on existing authority, and identify low quality content. The company claims its technology produces cluster analyses and content plans in minutes, against dozens of hours of manual work.

MarketMuse is tracked as a product in the writing and editing category, covering content strategy AI, topic modeling, site-wide content audit, and competitive intelligence. No litigation, MCP server, or other filings are recorded for the company.
